title: "平方和的二分之三次根式积分"

求不定积分
$$
\int\frac{dx}{(x^2+1)^{3/2}}.
$$

<!-- answer -->

令 $x=\tan\theta$，$-\frac\pi2<\theta<\frac\pi2$，则 $\sec\theta>0$，所以
$$
\begin{aligned}
\int\frac{dx}{(x^2+1)^{3/2}}
&=\int\frac{\sec^2\theta}{\sec^3\theta}\,d\theta\\
&=\int\cos\theta\,d\theta
=\sin\theta+C\\
&=\boxed{\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+1}}+C}.
\end{aligned}
$$
